plugins.name: pb-hcf
plugins.description: Full custom-workflow integration for HCF v2.0.0+ — 14 enrollable agents across 7 hook points (pre-plan, post-plan, pre-implementation, post-batch, post-implementation, pre-commit, post-commit), replaces /proxiblue-skills:workflow-build-feature, multi-playbook wire installer with RO-mount-respecting host-side enrollment, deterministic hook discovery + SessionStart auto-inject, opt-in via /pb-hcf:wire --enable=<name> or --enable-all.
